findings.title: Runbook integrated correctly
findings.description: redis-server added to Step 1 package list, both new units added to Step 4 install steps, config files table updated, log commands section enhanced with new journalctl examples

findings.title: Environment guidance updated with issue reference
findings.description: Comment block updated to direct operators to uncomment REDIS_URL/CELERY_BROKER_URL/CELERY_RESULT_BACKEND when enabling workers (Issue #720), replacing stale 'leave unset' guidance

reliabilityFindings.detail: Both units use Restart=on-failure with RestartSec=5, matching existing juli-api.service pattern. Workers will recover from temporary failures.
Secrets sourced from AWS Secrets Manager via ExecStartPre fetch-secrets.sh script; no hardcoded credentials in systemd unit files or git-tracked env templates.

securityChecksPassed: No hardcoded secrets in unit files
Secret fetch integrated via existing fetch-secrets.sh (AWS Secrets Manager)
Environment file references stable /etc/juli/api.env outside release tree
No injection vectors or unsafe command construction
Correct use of EnvironmentFile for dynamic secret loading per deploy phase

observabilityFindings.detail: Units configured with --loglevel=info; runbook includes journalctl examples for both services (recent errors, continuous tail)
Runbook documents systemctl status command for checking service health; standard systemd integration

acceptance.note: Infrastructure/documentation-only issue with no new tests. Scope containment verified by existing test_phase_2_5_deploy_config.py (18/18 PASS).

releaseReadiness.notes: New systemd unit files are inert until manually installed on VPS (/etc/systemd/system/) and enabled by operator. Deploy-release.sh not modified; merging and deploying this PR does not activate workers automatically.

correctionsMade.issue: Initial version included BindsTo=juli-api.service (violation of pattern-follow spec requirement)
correctionsMade.fix: Removed BindsTo; unit now has only After= and Wants= dependencies on network-online.target and redis-server.service per juli-api.service pattern
